# Six months of
Linear, on us

A dedicated offer for Claude for Startups’s community. Built for teams that plan, build, and ship ambitious products.

1. 1.0

   ### Press redeem

    to attach the partner offer before signing up or choosing a workspace.
2. 2.0

   ### Sign up or log in

   Create a Linear account or log in. The offer stays attached as you move through the flow.
3. 3.0

   ### Choose your workspace

   Select the workspace where the offer should apply. You need to be an admin to redeem it.

## Questions
and answers

To redeem the offer you must be affiliated with [an official Linear partner](https://linear.app/startups#partners). The offer is only valid for non-paying Linear users with less than 50 employees.

Only companies affiliated with an official Linear partner can participate in the program. Linear does, however, offer a generous [free plan](https://linear.app/pricing) that includes all major features, allows unlimited workspace members, and 250 issues (plus unlimited archived issues). If your investor is not part of the program and you think they should be, [ask them to apply](https://linear.app/startups#apply).

The Linear startup program is designed for early-stage startups. Only companies with fewer than 50 employees are eligible to participate. If your company is larger, [please contact our sales team](https://linear.app/contact/sales).

Yes. Ask your investor or accelerator to [fill out this form](https://linear.app/startups#apply) to apply to become a Linear partner and we’ll get back to you.

Follow the redemption link provided by your partner, or enter your partner code when prompted. You need to be an admin of your Linear workspace and logged into your account to redeem the offer.

When your discount period ends, your Business subscription automatically renews at the standard rate unless you switch plans or cancel beforehand.
